description: This file contains the PHP class 'VoucherTheme' within the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Sale'. It defines various controller methods for managing voucher themes in the OpenCart admin panel, including listing, form handling, saving, and deleting voucher themes. The class extends a base Controller class and interacts with models, views, and language files to facilitate CRUD operations for voucher themes.

classes.name: VoucherTheme
classes.description: Controller class managing voucher themes (listing, form, save, delete) in the admin panel of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the list of voucher themes with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of voucher themes as a view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the voucher themes list with data, pagination, and sorting links.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a voucher theme.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the POST request to save or update a voucher theme.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of selected voucher themes, including permission checks and JSON response.
